title: content[0].text is undefined when the model returns a thinking block first
symptoms: Diagnosis or summary field silently falls back to a placeholder
Works on small prompts, fails on real ones
cause: Models with adaptive thinking can put a thinking block before the text block. Whether they do depends on the prompt, so short tests return text first and look fine.
fix: Collect every block whose type is text and join them; fail loudly when there is none. Test with the real payload, not a toy prompt.
apply: const text = res.content.filter(b => b.type === 'text').map(b => b.text).join(''); if (!text) throw new Error('no text block, stop_reason=' + res.stop_reason);
affected: Claude models with adaptive thinking, July 2026
